findings.governingReading: After imperial protection ends, her country rapidly fragments into various small kingdoms.
findings.explanation: Countries removes the monarchical political structure and various becomes only a comparative size.

findings.governingReading: The golden inscription names the rightful king of Britain.
findings.explanation: The borrowed Arthurian wording substitutes England for Britain, changing the polity named by this script.

findings.highlight: someone who kills everyone to protect everyone
findings.evidenceJa: 一番多くみんなを殺す存在
findings.governingReading: The king protects everyone by becoming the person who kills more people than anyone else.
findings.explanation: Kills everyone turns the paradox of bearing the greatest lethal burden into indiscriminate total slaughter.

findings.evidenceJa: 何処に、失ってしまった
findings.governingReading: The dream closes by asking where she could have lost such a celebrated sword.
findings.explanation: How replaces the explicit mystery of where the sword was lost with a question about the manner of its loss.

findings.highlight: I guess I fell asleep after coming back to my room
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを看ながら眠ってしまった
findings.governingReading: Unable to decide, Shirou falls asleep while watching over Saber.
findings.explanation: The English omits that he remained at Saber’s bedside, weakening the continuity of his care and the setting of the awakening.

findings.governingReading: Shirou lets out a long, heavy breath before reaching for his sweating forehead.
findings.explanation: Take a deep breath reverses exhalation into inhalation and loses the sighing release.

findings.highlight: He must have been shooting arrows until now
findings.evidenceJa: 先ほどまで弓を引いていたのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou initially sees only that Archer appears to have been drawing his bow.
findings.explanation: The English asserts he was shooting arrows, immediately contradicting the reveal that he used none.

findings.highlight: did not intend to use her Noble Phantasm until the very end
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まで宝具を使う気はなかった
findings.governingReading: Archer cautiously infers that Saber intended never to use her Noble Phantasm throughout the fight.
findings.explanation: Until the very end can mean that she planned to use it at the final moment, reversing the point that protecting Shirou made her abandon a settled refusal.
